name: Grade 7 English Term 1 Exam
subject: English
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Read the questions carefully.

items.question: Which of these is a synonym of 'happy'?
Fill in: Neither the teacher nor the students ____ present.
A group of lions is called a?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (46 marks)
items: 1. Read the passage and answer: 'Juma woke up early to prepare for the inter-school games.' What did Juma wake up early to prepare for? (2 marks)
2. Write the plural of: loaf, mouse, tooth (3 marks)
3. Rewrite in reported speech: 'I will come tomorrow,' said Mary. (3 marks)
4. Use 'despite' in a sentence of your own. (2 marks)
5. Write the comparative and superlative of: good, bad, far (3 marks)
6. Punctuate: he asked where are you going (2 marks)
7. Write an antonym for each: ancient, victory, expand (3 marks)
